name: Pipedrive
one_liner: Sales CRM with a RESTful API (v1/v2), OAuth 2.0 Marketplace apps, webhooks and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: Personal API token generated in the Pipedrive app; OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow (oauth.pipedrive.com) required for Marketplace apps.
access_notes: Requires a Pipedrive company account (ZoomInfo review says API access on all paid plans incl. Lite $14/seat; trial not verified). Free developer sandbox account available via request form (5 seats; deleted if inactive). Developers in sanctioned countries are excluded. Token-based daily budget: 30,000 x plan multiplier x seats.

buildability.rationale: Documented REST API, API token and OAuth, free developer sandbox. Customers need a paid Pipedrive plan; daily token budget scales with plan and seats; Marketplace apps need OAuth and review.

needs_human_reason: Pricing page returned 403; whether a free trial account suffices for an API token is not verified from an official page. MCP URL comes from a vendor GitHub org plugin config only.

identity.quote: Pipedrive is a global CRM with headquarters in the USA and operations in the USA and EU, featuring an intuitive RESTful API.

auth.quote: The API token can be obtained manually from the Pipedrive app.
Using OAuth 2.0 is necessary for developing apps that are available in the Pipedrive Marketplace.

access.quote: Getting API access requires a paid Pipedrive account on any plan.
30,000 base tokens × subscription plan multiplier × number of seats

Each company account is allocated a daily API token budget, which is shared among all users within that account.
